content: To construct our test dataset, we used a publicly shared set of Consumer Health Questions (CHQs) received by the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), and annotated with named entities, question types, and focus BIBREF46 , BIBREF47 . The CHQ dataset consists of 1,721 consumer information requests manually annotated with subquestions, each identified by a question type and a focus.
